sources: Magicbricks Rental Index Apr–Jun 2026 (via Realty Today)
note: Rents in ₹ thousand per month [low, high] by BHK; p = sale ₹/sq ft [low, high]. Asking ranges for typical unfurnished/semi-furnished flats.

localities.name: Salt Lake (Bidhannagar)
localities.metro: Green Line: Karunamoyee, Central Park, City Centre, Bengal Chemical, Salt Lake Stadium
localities.pros: Planned blocks, wide roads and parks; 10–15 min to Sector V IT hub.
localities.cons: Little new supply, mostly older houses and low-rise floors; some blocks waterlog in heavy rain.
societies: Independent floors in CA, CD, BD, FD, AE blocks

localities.name: New Town (Action Areas I–III)
localities.metro: Green Line Sector V nearby; Orange Line stations to the airport under construction (target Dec 2026)
localities.pros: Newest gated societies with pools and clubs; Eco Park, Tata Medical Center, planned roads.
localities.cons: Patchy public transport until the Orange Line opens; fewer old-city markets; low-lying pockets flood.
societies: DLF New Town Heights (Action Area III)

localities.name: Rajarhat & Chinar Park
localities.metro: Orange Line Chinar Park & VIP Road stations under construction
localities.pros: Cheaper than New Town; close to the airport and City Centre 2.
localities.cons: Older Rajarhat belt has weaker roads and drainage; VIP Road traffic.

localities.name: Baguiati & Kestopur
localities.metro: Orange Line along VIP Road under construction; Yellow Line Jai Hind (Airport) about 3 km
localities.pros: Among the cheapest rents with quick reach to Salt Lake and New Town.

localities.name: Lake Town & Bangur
localities.metro: Dum Dum (Blue Line) and Dum Dum Cantonment (Yellow Line) 2–3 km
localities.pros: Established and lively, with big markets and the lake; close to Salt Lake.
localities.cons: Dense; heavy traffic on Jessore Road.

localities.name: Dum Dum
localities.metro: Blue Line Dum Dum; Yellow Line Dum Dum Cantonment, Jessore Road
localities.pros: Metro plus suburban rail; airport 15–20 min.

localities.name: Kankurgachi & Phoolbagan
localities.metro: Green Line Phoolbagan; Orange Line Beleghata nearby
localities.pros: Central-east; 15 min to Sector V and Sealdah.

localities.name: Central (Park Street, Elgin, Camac St)
localities.metro: Blue Line Park Street, Maidan, Esplanade; Green Line Esplanade
localities.pros: Heart of the city: restaurants, hospitals, top schools and offices.

localities.name: Ballygunge & Gariahat
localities.metro: Blue Line Kalighat / Rabindra Sarobar about 1.5 km; Ballygunge suburban rail
localities.pros: Premium old-Kolkata address; Gariahat market, lakes, schools.
localities.cons: High rents; many older buildings with few amenities.

localities.name: Lake Gardens & Dhakuria
localities.metro: Suburban rail Lake Gardens & Dhakuria; Blue Line Rabindra Sarobar about 1.5 km
localities.pros: Next to Rabindra Sarobar lake; quiet and residential.

localities.name: Jodhpur Park & Prince Anwar Shah Rd
localities.metro: Blue Line Tollygunge / Netaji about 2 km; Lake Gardens rail about 1 km
localities.pros: South City township with mall, school and club; established neighbourhood.

localities.name: Tollygunge
localities.metro: Blue Line Mahanayak Uttam Kumar (Tollygunge), Netaji, Masterda Surya Sen
localities.pros: Metro on the doorstep; Tollygunge Club; good markets.

localities.name: New Alipore & Alipore
localities.metro: Purple Line Majerhat / Taratala about 1.5 km; Blue Line Jatin Das Park about 2.5 km
localities.pros: Leafy and upscale, top schools, quick to Park Street.

localities.name: Behala
localities.metro: Purple Line: Behala Chowrasta, Behala Bazar, Taratala, Sakher Bazar
localities.pros: Affordable, Purple Line metro, lots of new mid-rise flats.
localities.cons: Diamond Harbour Road congestion; some waterlogging.

localities.name: EM Bypass (Kasba to Mukundapur)
localities.metro: Orange Line: Satyajit Ray, Jyotirindra Nandi, Kavi Sukanta, Hemanta Mukhopadhyay (Ruby), VIP Bazar, Ritwik Ghatak, Barun Sengupta
localities.pros: Big gated complexes, the hospital belt and the Orange Line; about 25 min to Sector V.

localities.name: Jadavpur & Santoshpur
localities.metro: Suburban rail Jadavpur; Orange Line Kavi Sukanta / Satyajit Ray 1.5–2 km
localities.pros: University buzz, cheap eats, good bus links.

localities.name: Garia & Patuli
localities.metro: Blue Line Kavi Nazrul, Shahid Khudiram; Orange Line Satyajit Ray on the Patuli side
localities.pros: Affordable and metro-linked; Patuli lake.

localities.name: Narendrapur & Sonarpur
localities.metro: Suburban rail Narendrapur / Sonarpur; Kavi Subhash metro about 4 km (station being rebuilt)
localities.pros: New gated projects at low prices; Ramakrishna Mission campus.

localities.name: Joka
localities.metro: Purple Line Joka
localities.pros: IIM Calcutta, open land, new townships at low prices.
localities.cons: Far out; limited social infrastructure so far.

localities.name: Greater Kailash I & II
localities.metro: Magenta Line Greater Kailash, Chirag Delhi; Violet Line Kailash Colony
localities.pros: Premium South Delhi; M-Block and N-Block markets, parks. Avg rent Apr–Jun 2026: 2 BHK ₹66.5k, 3 BHK ₹1.36 lakh.
localities.cons: Very expensive; mostly builder floors; parking is tight.
societies: Builder floors in M, N, S, W blocks (GK I)

localities.name: Kalkaji & Govindpuri
localities.metro: Kalkaji Mandir (Violet + Magenta), Govindpuri (Violet)
localities.pros: Next to Nehru Place offices, two metro lines. Avg rent: 2 BHK ₹43.2k, 3 BHK ₹85.8k.

localities.name: Vasant Kunj
localities.metro: Yellow Line Chhattarpur 2–3 km; Golden Line (Aerocity–Tughlakabad) stations under construction
localities.pros: Green DDA pockets, malls, 15 min to the airport and Gurugram. Avg rent: 2 BHK ₹47.8k, 3 BHK ₹76.6k.
localities.cons: Weak metro access until the Golden Line opens.

localities.name: Vasant Vihar
localities.metro: Magenta Line Vasant Vihar
localities.pros: Embassy belt; very green and quiet.

localities.name: Saket
localities.metro: Yellow Line Saket
localities.pros: Select Citywalk, Max hospital, metro. Avg rent: 2 BHK ₹29.6k, 3 BHK ₹61.9k.

localities.name: Malviya Nagar
localities.metro: Yellow Line Malviya Nagar
localities.pros: Lively market and cafes, next to Saket. Avg rent: 2 BHK ₹43.7k, 3 BHK ₹69k.

localities.name: Hauz Khas & Green Park
localities.metro: Hauz Khas (Yellow + Magenta), Green Park (Yellow)
localities.pros: Deer Park, Hauz Khas Village; AIIMS and IIT close by.

localities.name: Lajpat Nagar
localities.metro: Lajpat Nagar (Violet + Pink)
localities.pros: Central Market, interchange station, central location.

localities.name: Defence Colony
localities.metro: Violet Line Lajpat Nagar / JLN Stadium about 1.5 km
localities.pros: Upscale, central, Defence Colony market.

localities.name: Moti Nagar & Kirti Nagar
localities.metro: Blue Line Moti Nagar, Kirti Nagar; Green Line Kirti Nagar
localities.pros: Rare large gated societies inside Delhi.

localities.name: Rajouri Garden & Punjabi Bagh
localities.metro: Rajouri Garden (Blue + Pink), Punjabi Bagh (Green + Pink)
localities.pros: Malls and food streets; well connected.

localities.name: Paschim Vihar
localities.metro: Green Line Paschim Vihar East/West, Peeragarhi (Magenta interchange coming)
localities.pros: District park, DDA societies, calm. Avg rent: 2 BHK ₹27.3k, 3 BHK ₹46.1k.
societies: DDA SFS and group housing societies

localities.name: Janakpuri
localities.metro: Blue Line Janakpuri East/West; Magenta Line Janakpuri West
localities.pros: District Centre and hospitals; airport 20 min.

localities.name: Dwarka (Sectors 3–23)
localities.metro: Blue Line Dwarka Sec 8–21; Airport Express Dwarka Sec 21
localities.pros: Planned sub-city of CGHS societies, wide roads, close to the airport and Gurugram.
localities.cons: Far from central and east Delhi; groundwater issues in some sectors.

localities.name: Uttam Nagar
localities.metro: Blue Line Uttam Nagar East/West, Nawada
localities.pros: Cheapest metro-linked area in west Delhi.

localities.name: Rohini
localities.metro: Red Line Rohini East/West, Rithala; Yellow Line Rohini Sector 18-19
localities.pros: Huge planned sub-city of CGHS and DDA flats; good value.
societies: CGHS societies in Sectors 9, 13, 24 and others

localities.name: Pitampura
localities.metro: Red Line Pitampura, Kohat Enclave; Magenta Line extension to Majlis Park (opened Mar 2026)
localities.pros: Netaji Subhash Place; settled family area.

localities.name: Ashok Vihar & Shalimar Bagh
localities.metro: Pink Line Shalimar Bagh, Azadpur; Yellow Line Azadpur
localities.pros: Spacious DDA pockets and parks.

localities.name: Model Town & North Campus
localities.metro: Yellow Line Model Town, GTB Nagar, Vishwavidyalaya
localities.pros: Delhi University, PGs, Kamla Nagar market.

localities.name: Karol Bagh & Rajinder Nagar
localities.metro: Blue Line Karol Bagh, Rajendra Place
localities.pros: Central, 10 min to Connaught Place; coaching hub.

localities.name: Mayur Vihar Phase 1
localities.metro: Mayur Vihar-1 (Blue + Pink)
localities.pros: Close to Noida and CP; interchange station; DDA societies. Avg rent: 2 BHK ₹28.1k, 3 BHK ₹42.6k.

localities.name: IP Extension & Patparganj
localities.metro: Pink Line IP Extension; Blue Line Nirman Vihar about 2 km
localities.pros: Dozens of CGHS societies with parks; quick to Noida.

localities.name: Laxmi Nagar & Preet Vihar
localities.metro: Blue Line Laxmi Nagar, Nirman Vihar, Preet Vihar
localities.pros: Cheap; coaching hub; 15 min to CP.

localities.name: Sarita Vihar & Jasola
localities.metro: Violet Line Sarita Vihar, Jasola Apollo; Magenta Line Jasola Vihar
localities.pros: Apollo Hospital; close to Noida and Okhla offices; DDA pockets.

localities.name: Chhattarpur
localities.metro: Yellow Line Chhattarpur
localities.pros: Budget South Delhi with metro; near Gurugram.
